about_the_game:
Into Oblivion is an immersive interactive novel where your choices shape the story. Beautiful writing and intuitive game design collide to form a truly unique experience. Storylines branch and wave - dynamically changing depending on your decisions in various unexpected ways. A single choice can completely change the story and its meaning.

Story Synopsis

Humanity has settled across the stars - spreading far and wide across the galaxy. The Galactic War between the stellar systems ended decades ago. Born into an age of relative peace and prosperity, you are free to choose your own path in life. Work for a struggling starship manufacturer, an omnipotent investment megacorporation, the largest military force to ever grace the galaxy or even the most popular religion. However you must take heed for not everything is at it seems. The fate of the entire universe barely hangs by a single thread - ready to snap at any moment.

So, settle your mind and pray you have what it takes to fly Into Oblivion.

Game Engine

Into Oblivion is built inside INCK (Interactive Novel Creation Kit) created by NanoLion.

content_descriptors.notes:
- Written descriptions of physical violence such as being shot or stabbed
- Written descriptions of characters dying, including from the player's direct actions
- Written descriptions of suicide and its effects
- Written descriptions of characters using alcohol, legal and illegal drugs
- Written descriptions of violence against vulnerable groups such as the elderly and financially unstable
- Characters speaking in crude language and/or with profanity

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or Greater
  • Processor: >1GHz Quad Core CPU
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated Graphics
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Best played alone at night
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: 2GHz Hexa Core CPU
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated Graphics
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Best played alone at night
